gaps.summary: The deploy replaces instances one at a time over 15 minutes, but the migration drops price_dollars first, so the old instances still running fail on every read and write of a price.
TRUNC drops the fraction, and a REAL price such as 0.53 times 100 is just under 53, so it is stored a cent low. The admin screens' int(dollars * 100) saves 19.99 as 1998.

ADD COLUMN takes an exclusive lock on products, held by the single transaction through the update of 4 million rows, so catalog reads and admin edits wait for the whole migration, against the 20 ms read target.
The migration drops price_dollars in the same release, so a rollback of the code has no column to read, and the original values are gone.
